name: Pixelmole – Follow-up emails
author: pixelmole

sections.description:
This plugin lets you send automatic follow-up emails after a purchase. Define the subject, body, and delay easily from your WooCommerce settings.

Features

  • Send automatic follow-up emails after order completion
  • Define delay in minutes, hours, or days
  • Custom email subject and message
  • Test email function included
  • Works with Mailpit, WP Mail SMTP, or any SMTP setup

Disclaimer

Use this plugin at your own risk. Always test on a staging site first.
sections.installation:
1. Upload pixelmole-follow-up-emails to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to WooCommerce → Settings → Follow-up emails to configure.

short_description: Easily create and send follow-up emails that keep your customers engaged. No coding, just results.
